sanskrit: papraccha girijā kāntā punarnatvā vṛṣadhvajamidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kriyoḍḍīśaṃ vibho vadagopitavyaṃ prayatnena mama svaprāṇavallabheśītāṃśusalilakṣoṇīvyomavāyuhavirbhujaḥdurgā caiva bhadrakālī karmādau tāḥ prapūjayetiti kriyoḍḍīśamahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde prathamaḥ paṭalaḥidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi rogamuktaḥ kathaṃ prabho!jvarādivāraṇaṃ śīghra kṛpayā parayā vadakathayāmi tava snehāt kavacaṃ vāraṇaṃ mahatgrahajvarādibhūteṣu sarvakarmasu yojayettaddatte siddhihāniḥ syādyoginīnāṃ bhavetpaśuḥsadācārarato yaśca nirjitāśeṣa eva hisarve jvarā vinaśyanti kavacaṃ dhārayedyadiavaśyameva siddhiḥ syātsatyaṃ satyaṃ varānaneiti kriyoḍḍīśamahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥviśeṣataḥ sarvaroge tryambakasya prapūjanamtataḥ prayogaṃ sarveṣāṃ vaśyādīnāṃ ca kārayetvidhānaṃ tatra vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalānanetatrānīya mṛtaṃ muṇḍaṃ sthāpayitvā mamārcanamuttare dakṣiṇe vāpi pūrve ca paścime tathādayāṃ kuru mahābhāga siddhido bhava majjapedayāṃ kurvantu te sarve siddhidāśca bhavantu metataḥ sthānaṃ tu saṃspṛśya vaśyo bhava vadeditisnānaṃ tu pañcagavyena dadhidugdhādikaṃ tathāpañcāmṛtaistataḥ snānaṃ kārayetparameśvari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tṛtīye sadyojātāya caturthe ca pinākadhṛktato jīvanyāsaṃ kṛtvā nyāsādikaṃ tataḥ paramdhyānaṃ śṛṇu mahādeva! snehena kathitaṃ mayāsvacchāmbhojagataṃ navendumukuṭaṃ devaṃ trinetraṃ bhajejapāparājitā kṛṣṇabilvapatraṃ ca pippalamaṣṭādhikaśatenaiva pūjayetguḍārdrakarasenaiva surāstu brāhmaṇasya tuśūdrasya tāmrapātre tu madhuyuktaṃ nivedayetjuhuyātsarvakarmāṇi kathitāni maheśvari!matraṃ śṛṇu mahādevi! kathitaṃ tava śraddhayābilvamūle śmaśāne vā nirjane ca prapūjayetata eva kathitaṃ me ca satyaṃ satyaṃ varānaneiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥcatvāraḥ kumbhāḥ saṃsthāpyāḥ pañcapallavasaṃyutāḥpalāśasamidhā homam uktamantreṇa tatkramātiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde caturthaḥ paṭalaḥtriṃśadbhirdhanasiddhistu pañcāśanmantrasiddhayeyantrāṇyetāni saṃlikhya vāhayenmantrapūrvakamiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yantraṃ kathaya me prabhomāyātmakaṃ tena bhavet ṣaṭkoṇaṃ yantramuttamamdugdhādinā tathā devi śāntau mṛtyuñjaye'pi caśatatolakamānena dravyametprakīrtitambilvapatraṃ tathā puṣpaṃ dadyādaṣṭottaraṃ śatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: stambhane mohane caiva dhattūraṃ kanakāhvayamcaturdaśyāṃ samārabhya yāvadanyā caturdaśīaṣṭādhikasahasraṃ tu japaṃ kuryāddine dinecaṇḍogreṇa vidhānena japapūjādikaṃ smṛtamtraiyambakeṇa deveśi ! śāntike japapūjanamjātidhvaṃse kulocchede jvarādau rogasaṅkaṭeyatnena pūjayeddevi liṅgamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamnīlakaṇṭhena vā devi stavena toṣayecchivampāpebhyo narakebhyaśca trāhi māṃ bhaktavatsalalobhamohānmahādeva rakṣa māṃ tridaśeśvarakāyena manasā vācā tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhāstu memahādevaprasādena bhairavena ca kīrtitamprāpnoti sukhamārogyaṃ putramāyuḥ pravarddhanamvidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ mokṣārthī mokṣameva cabrahmahatyādi pāpaṃ ca paṭhanādeva naśyatiiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥvyāghrājine sarvasiddhirjñānasiddhirmṛgājinekauśeyaṃ puṣṭidaṃ proktaṃ kambalaṃ sarvasiddhidammeṣāsanaṃ tu vaśyārthamākṛṣṭau vyāghracarma cagocarma stambhane devi! vājiṃ cocāṭane tathāsarvakāmārthadaṃ devi! paṭṭavastrāsanaṃ tathāduḥkhadāridryanāśaṃ tu kāṣṭhapāṣāṇajāsanamhastamātreṇa tatkuryādvālukābhiḥ suśobhanamekena mantrayugmena sthāpitāḥ syuḥ sapallavaiḥkadācidapi caikena sarvānnācchādayecchive
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsi casarvatīrthāni puṇyāni ghaṭe kurvantu sannidhimdroṇaṃ vā karavīraṃ vā manobhīṣṭaphalaṃ labhetdroṇaiśca ketakīpuṣpairhomo rogaṃ vimocayetbilvapatraṃ kuruvakaṃ munipuṣpaṃ ca kesaramraktotpalaṃ bilvapatraṃ kāñcanaṃ raktavarṇakamjuhuyāttu maheśāni sarvasiddhirbhavettadāiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde navamaḥ paṭalaḥpūrve ca yādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tādṛśaṃ ca prapaśyatikiyaddṛṣṭamañjanañca timiraṃ hanti sundaripunarnavāghṛtaṃ sadyaścakṣustejaḥkaraṃ bhavetsvātyāṃ tathā vaiṣṇave ca jvaraṃ hanti sudāruṇamanena manunā devi! tṛṣṇānāśo bhaviṣyatisarvasiddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanammahāvyādhipraśamanamapasmāravināśanamtatra sthāne na tiṣṭhanti ḍākinyādyā viśeṣataḥṣoḍaśāraṃ likhetpadmaṃ yoniyugmaṃ sabindukamtanmadhye caiva ṣaṭkoṇaṃ likhenmūlamanusmarantasya madhye nyaset kumbhaṃ gale sragdāmabhūṣitampūjayecca yathānyāsaṃ pāyasantu nivedayetgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya tadbāhye kṣetrapālakānjuhuyādājyāpāmārgeṇa rakṣatāṃ bhidamarṣaṇaukuṇḍe va sthaṇḍile vāpi homakarma samācaretkuṇḍamadhye nyaseddevīṃ dakṣiṇe ca śriyaṃ smarettasyaiva vāmapārśve tu pūjayeddaśa nāyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ayutaṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ japet parimāṇaṃ viduḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ puṇyāṃ gatimavāpnuyāttasyāvaśyaṃ na vidyeta vyādhibhyo'pi bhayaṃ nahiiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde daśamaḥ paṭalaḥsugupte vijane deśe gomayenopalepitenavakumbhān samādāya śuddhakumbhena pūrayetkumbhopari samāropya dīpaṃ prajvālayettataḥatītānāgatañcaiva vartamānaṃ ca yadbhavetsamyagdhyātvā gaṇeśānaṃ gate yāme japenniśikanyakārthī śucirbhūtvā mantrarājaṃ gaṇeśituḥpuṣpairdaśāṃśahavanāt tāṃ kanyāṃ labhate dhruvamśāstroktenaiva mantreṇa saṃkṣepānna tu vistarātśuklālaṅkārasampannaṃ bhāvayedyo nirantaramnityaṃ prakāśate satyaṃ divyajñānapradāyinīanaṅgavaśasampannā tamabhyeti varāṅganāyaḥ smarettasya vaśagā hyavaśyā'pi varāṅganāprativādimukhe dhyāyanprajapenmanasā manumtanmukhaṃ stambhayedāśu vādī dīno'pi nānyathācintayitvā gaṇeśānaṃ cidambarasudhārasamsarvarogavinirmuktaścirakālaṃ sa jīvatiśuklāmbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ cicchaśāṃkāmṛtaplutammantrī garuḍavat sadyastrividhaṃ harate viṣamghṛtena lakṣmīsamprāptyai hunet śarkarayā tathāannena cānnasampattyai dravyāptyai tilataṇḍulaiḥsaubhāgyārthī tathā lājaiḥ kusumaiścāpi sodanaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aśvatthodumbaraplakṣanyagrodhasamidho hunetviprakṣatriyaviṭśūdrāḥ sadyo vaśyā bhavanti vaisājyāhutitrayantasya vaśamāyānti nānyathādaśāṃśe juhuyānmantrī rājikālavaṇena casamāgacchati sā nārī madanānalavihvalāstambhayedripusainyaṃ ca sāmātyabalavāhanamstambhayet pañcadravyāṇi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāsamyaguccāṭayecchatrūn svasthānāttu viśeṣataḥgrāmayuddhe pure vāpi imaṃ stutvā tu homayetuccāṭayati vegena mānuṣeṣu ca kā kathāmṛtakeśaistu saṃveṣṭya sahasrāṣṭābhimantritamsaptāhānmaraṇaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥsusame bhūtale śuddhe gajādyaiḥ supariṣkṛtesaṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ gaṇeśaṃ śaṅkarātmajamkastūrīrocanāyantrakāśmīraṃ candanaṃ rasamsarvaiśca susamairebhiḥ prāṇamāpūrya saṃlikhetṣaṭtriṃśatkoṇamaṣṭāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ tataḥ parammahābhūmaṇḍalaṃ kuryādgajāṣṭakavibhūṣitamkarṇikāyāṃ likhenmantrī dakṣau praṇavaveṣṭitaudvādaśāre likhecchaktiṃ vinā napuṃsakasvaramkādimantākṣarañcāpi sarvaṃ pūrvādito likhetetanmantraṃ samākhyātaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacitaṇimādyaṣṭamantreṇa cāṣṭabāhuṃ prapūjayetbhojayitvā vidhānena nānāmiṣṭaphalādibhiḥmūṣikaṃ pūjayāmāsa nānāmiṣṭaphalādibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityanenaiva mantreṇa mūṣikaṃ pūjayettataḥiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje śivagaurīsaṃvāde ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥkātvaṃ tvallākinīyuktaṃ vāmakarṇendubhūṣitamsādhyanāma tato nyasya vaśamānaya tatparamjātīpuṣpairhomena vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥyāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ smaraṇaṃ ca prajāyateśatena mantridaṃ kṛtvā tilakaṃ kārayettataḥcāmuṇḍā śavavāhinī japavidhau dhyeyā sadā sādhakaiḥnavāṃgulaṃ kīlakaṃ tat saptavārābhimantritamtattatsthāne yathāsaṃkhyāmanukte tvayutaṃ japetiti kriyoḍḍīśamahātantrarāje gaurīśvarasaṃvāde dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥkalaho jāyate nityaṃ śatrorgehe na saṃśayaḥmahiṣāśvapurīṣābhyāṃ gomūtreṇa samālikhetyayornāma tayoḥ śīghraṃ vidveṣaśca parasparamyayornāma tayoḥ śīghraṃ vidveṣaśca parasparammantraṃ tataḥ pravakṣyāmi mahābhairavasaṃjñakamvahnikuṇḍe śmaśānāgniṃ dīpayet khādiraindhasāhomayedayutaṃ dhīmānsākaṃ tilayavākṣataiḥvyomanīlāṃ mahācaṇḍāṃ surāsuravimardinīmkapālakartṛkāhastāṃ candrasūryoparisthitāmvasantīṃ pitṛgahane sarvasiddhipradāyinīmpūjayitvā maheśānīṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasābhasmanā tena manunā vidveṣo jāyate nṛṇāmsaptāhā'bhyantare śatrorāśu coccāṭanambhavetkāmyaprayoge sarvatra niyamo'yutasaṃkhyakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yena vijñātamātreṇa susādhyaṃ bhuvanatrayebhuvanabhayaṃkarīti padaṃ varmāstramuccarenmanumyaddīrghayuktabījena cāṅgamantreṇa yojanāśikhākavacanetrāstramevaṃ nyāsakramaḥ smṛtaḥmahākṛtyā devatā ca ityuktyā nyāsamācaretdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ trinetrāṃ sarvaprojjvalāmtriśūlacakramuśalakhaṭvāṅgakarapaṅkajāmdhyātvā kṛtyāṃ vidhānena pūjayenmantravittamaḥkṛṣṇairmāraṇakṛtyeṣu māṃsaraktāsavaiḥ stutāmbhīṣaṇāṃ śrīmatīṃ caiva pratiṣṭhāñca tataḥ parampūrve tu śāṃkarīṃ nāma śuklavarṇāṃ varānvitāmdakṣiṇe bhīṣikāṃ nāma lambajihvāṃ sudhāmukhīmcaturbhujāṃ siṃhanādāṃ mahāghoṣāṃ kapālinīmpaścime vāruṇīṃ nāma svarṇavarṇāṃ hasanmukhīmuttare bhīmikāṃ nāma caturhastāṃ bhayaṅkarīmavāpya viniyogastu kartavyo mantriṇā sadādvādaśāṃgulakaṃ śatrornakhalomasamanvitamasya prāṇān pratiṣṭhāpya maricairlepayettataḥbaddhvā kare karamaye toraṇe cā'pyadhomukhamtatra śāraṃ vidhāyāgniṃ paristīrya śaraistṛṇaiḥjuhuyānnimbatailāktaiḥ kākolūkasya pucchakaiḥaṣṭottaraśatenaiva manunā vidhinā tataḥyo me dveṣṭi janaḥ kaściddūrastho vāntike'pi casaṃrakṣyāgniṃ vidhānena navarātraṃ samācaretarkakṣīre ca maricaṃ piṣṭvā siddhārthameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇāmbarottarīyāgrapādenākramya tadripumnavarātrāt pare śatrurmriyate nātra saṃśayaḥvaṭukaṃ vimalāṅgākhyaṃ pūjayet ṣaṭsu karmasuabhyarcya ca śiraḥpadme śrīguruṃ karuṇāmayrudraṃ ca pūjayeddevi dhyānaṃ śṛṇu mahāmate!evaṃ dhyātvā mahākālīṃ pūjayedrudradaivatamprāṇāyāmamaṅganyāsaṃ pīṭhanyāsaṃ samācaretabhiṣekaṃ tarpaṇañca yathāvidhi samācareteṣā śāntirmahāśāntiḥ kathivā tava śraddhayāataḥ paraṃ mahādevi! pūjanaṃ krūrakarmaṇibhakṣaya svagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ sārameyasamanvitamidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kavacaṃ vai ṣaṭkarmaṇāmśravaṇāt paṭhanādvāpi śatrunāśāya tatkṣaṇāttrailokyaśatruṃ saṃhantu nāśitaṃ yatkṣamaṃ bhavetdevīṃ prabodhayāmāsa vākyenāmṛtavarṣiṇāparāniṣṭe mahādevi ! kutaste jāyate matiḥye yathā māṃ prapadyante śrutirasti purātanīśatrūṇāṃ prāṇanāśārthamuccāṭanavaśīkṛtauteṣāṃ hi balanāśārthaṃ sarvadā prayatā narāḥyasya dhāraṇamātreṇa śatrūṇāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavetśaraṇāgatamātrantu nāśituṃ naiva śakyateśatrūṇāṃ prāṇanāśārthaṃ kupitaḥ kāla eva saḥnāśayitvā kṣaṇaṃ devi anyaśatrūn vināśayabhūrje vilikhitañcaitat svarṇasthaṃ dhārayedyaditrailokyaṃ mohayetkrodhāttrailokyaṃ cūrṇayetkṣaṇāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmāstrādīni śastrāṇi tadgātrasparśanāttataḥmāsamātreṇa śatrūṇāṃ mahavipadakāraṇamtaṃ taṃ nāśayate sadyastathyaṃ te tadvadāmyahamhṛtkampo jāyate tāvadyāvattasya kṛpā na cetna vaktavyaṃ na draṣṭavyaṃ tava snehāt prakāśyatetacchṛṇuṣva mahādevi! trailokyamohanantvidamklīṃ dakṣiṇakālikādevatāyai sabhāmadhye jayapradāhrīṃ krīṃ krīṃ klīṃ trailokyaṃ vaśamānayadvāviṃśatyakṣarī brahma sarvatra rakṣa māṃ sadāsarvatra rakṣa māṃ devi śyāmā tūgrasvarūpiṇīsadā yastu paṭhedvāpi trailokyaṃ vaśamānayetsarvadā sa mahāvyādhipīḍito nātra saṃśayaḥdhāraṇaṃ kavacasyāsya bhūrjapatre viśeṣataḥśuklāṣṭamyāṃ likhenmantraṃ dhārayet svarṇapatrakeśikhāyāṃ dhārayedyogī phalārthī dakṣiṇe bhujegopanīyaṃ prayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ mahāmuneavaśyaṃ vaśamāyāti trailokyaṃ sacarācaramtatpāṭhānnāradenāpi mohitaṃ sacarācaramiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥsarvaṃ me kathitaṃ deva kavacaṃ na prakāśitamsarvarakṣākaraṃ devaṃ yadi sneho'sti sampratiṣaḍakṣarasvarūpo me vadanaṃ ca maheśvaraḥmṛtyuñjayastribījātmā āyū rakṣatu me sadāsadā māṃ sarvataḥ pātu ṣaṭtriṃśadvarṇarūpadhṛktrivarṇātmā nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ rakṣatu sarvadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadā rakṣatu me guhyaṃ sarvasampatpradāyakaḥmārtaṇḍabhairavo nityaṃ pādau me parirakṣatusadā māṃ raṇabhūmau tu rakṣatu tridaśādhipaḥdakṣiṇasyāṃ tatpuruṣo avyānme girināyakaḥuttarasyāṃ sadā pātu sadyojātaḥ svarūpadhṛkprātaḥkāle paṭhedyastu so'bhīṣṭaphalamāpnuyātdevā manuṣyā gandharvā vaśyāstasya na saṃśayaḥkarasthāstasya deveśi aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhayaḥrājatodarasaṃviṣṭāṃ kṛtvā ca dhārayetsudhīḥyasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācanaanyathā siddhihāniḥ syāt satyametanmanoramena deyaṃ kasyacidbhadre yadīcchedātmano hitamtenārcitā mahādevi! sarve devā na saṃśayaḥiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥprabhede kathitaṃ deva śāntiṃ mṛtasañjīvanīmmātṝṇāṃ tisṛṇāmamba garbhajāto yato haraḥvaśiṣṭho'sya ṛṣiḥ proktaśchando'nuṣṭubudāhṛtaḥvibhaktairmantravarṇaiśca ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ ca kalpanāmprācīraṃ cintanaṃ kuryāttataḥ saṅkalpamācarettataḥ paścāt karanyāsaṃ kuryācca mama sundarisākṣānmṛtyorvimucyeta kimanyāḥ kṣudrikāḥ kriyāḥdvisahasraṃ dūrvāvaṭajavābhi karavīrakaiḥvaṭavṛkṣasya samidhaṃ juhuyādayutāvadhiḥdhanadhānyasamṛddhiḥ syātsatyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvari!proccārya tryambakaṃ yo japati ca satataṃ saṃpuṭaṃ cānulomam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etanmantraṃ japedāśu vyādhimukto bhaveddhruvamdehaṃ devo dadhāno vidiśatu viśadā kalpajālāṃ śriyaṃ naḥmahāghoraṃ yadi tadā pūjayetparameśvaramtadvadasva mahādeva! kṛpāsti yadi māṃ pratihāriṇī siṃhinī caiva haṃsinī ca tato naṭīityaṣṭau nāyikāḥ proktāḥ sādhakānāṃ sukhāvahāḥkrodhāstradvayaṃ māyānte bhūtinīṃ ca trikūrcataḥkālaśyāmalavarṇikārmregabhujaṃgairveṣṭitā rakṣatujapedaṣṭasahasraṃ tu dhyāyedekāgramānasaḥcandanodakamiśreṇa dattvārghyaṃ tuṣyati dhruvamkarāmalakatāṃ kṛtvā mātā bhūtvā jagattrayambhaginī cenmahābhāgā sahasrayojanādapibhāryā cetpṛṣṭhamāropya svargaṃ prayāti nityaśaḥsarvāśāṃ pūrayatyeva sadā devī vibhūṣiṇīpāyātkuṇḍaladhāriṇī trijagatāmānandasandohabhūḥāyāti tatkṣaṇāddevī tataḥ kuṇḍaladhāriṇīkiṃ karttavyaṃ mayā vatsa mātaruktveti sādhakaḥataḥ parantu cārvaṅgi! sindūrahāriṇīmanuḥkūrcabījatrayaṃ cāstraṃ samproktaṃ vividhaṃ tathāsindūrahāriṇyasautattvasaṃkhyādinaṃ yāvajjapastattvasahasrakaḥkuryātsādhakavaryastu bhāryā bhavati kāmitārakṣati dvādaśadinaṃ devi sindūrahāriṇīmāyādvayaṃ krodhadvayaṃ siṃhinīti padantataḥhrīṃ hrīṃ phaṭ phaṭ siṃhinī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śailāgre nirjane vāpi siṃhinyāḥ pūjanaṃ tathāśeṣaṃ pātu samastamantakakulavyākalpamānā kalātato hṛṣṭātivaradā siṃhinī ceti pūjitāvastrayugmaṃ rasamayaṃ sādhakāya dine dinepraṇavañca trikūrcāstrahaṃsinīkathito manuḥdivyā kāñcanaratnahāralalitā śrīhaṃsinī pātu naḥavadhānena sampūjya japedayutasaṃkhyakamcandanārghyapradānena dṛṣṭā bhavati haṃsinīvastrālaṅkārabhojyāni divyārthaṃ samprayacchatiavaśeṣavyayābhāvānna dadāti prakupyatioṃ hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ phaṭ naṭī hūṁ hūṁ hūṁkūrcatrayantu mantro'yaṃ kathito nartakīmanuḥvīṇāgītaviśālinī bhagavatī vyāhāravākcāturīnaṭī susiddhā bhavati dhūpaṃ dadyānmuhurmuhaḥsadā kāmabhogadātrī bhāryā bhavati nartakīdine dine naṭī devī sthāyinī bhavati dhruvamataḥ paraṃ mahādevi ceṭyā ākarṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuceṭī krodhadvayañcoktaṃ ceṭī mantrottamottamaḥkiñciddharmasamāhitāpikaravā pāyātprabhā ceṭikādhruvaṃ ceṭī samāgatya ceṭīkarma karotyapiāgatya niyataṃ devī ceṭīkarma karoti caparaṃ ṅentaṃ krodhatrayaṃ kāmeśvaryā manuḥ smṛtaḥpāyāt puṣpadhanurdharā madhumukhī kāmeśvarī bhūtinīmāṃsādinā baliṃ dattvā sahasraṃ japamācaretjapanniśīthamāyāti raktenārghyaṃ nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvāśāṃ pūrayatyeva rājyaṃ yacchati niścitamṅe'ntaṃ krodhatrayaṃ guptaṃ kumārīmantramuttamamsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktā bhāryā bhavati sādhitāsitavastraṃ candanaṃ ca jyotiḥpuṣpaṃ pradāpayetjapānte nityamāyāti cumbanāliṅganādibhiḥdadātyaṣṭau ca dīnārāndivyavastrayugaṃ tathāanyāśramagṛhāddravyamānīyāśu prayacchatisatyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ śṛṇu me prāṇavallabhekrodhādhipaṃ vyomavaktraṃ vajrapāṇiṃ surāntakamkalikalpatarorvallī bhūtinī siddhirucyatesundaryādiprabhedena pratyekaṃ pūjayecchivetataḥ prāsādamāruhya pūjāsthānaṃ suśobhanamtatrasthaḥ sādhayedyogī yoginyādi ca bhūtinīmtato vidhivadācamya sūryārghyaṃ pradadettataḥgaṇeśaṃ baṭukañcaiva pūjayedyantrakoparigaṇeśaṃ krodhabhairavaṃ ca pūjayetparameśvaripūrvavacca punardhyātvā mānasaiḥ pūjayettataḥtanmadhye ca vinirmāya candanena vilepanamniśāyāṃ pūjayedvīraṃ divase pūjayetpaśumnirbhayaḥ sañjapenmantraṃ hṛdgataṃ ca nivedayetgagano grahaṇaścaiva yuktacandrārddhaśekharaḥsaṃkhyayāṣṭasahasrāśca sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥcandraśekhara taddhyānaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa vada prabhovyāghracarmāmbaradharaṃ trinetrāṃ bhīṣaṇānanāmdvibhujaṃ dakṣiṇe khaḍgaṃ kheṭakaṃ vāmahastakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhakāya prayacchantamabhayaṃ varameva cavikṛtāsyaṃ dvijihvaṃ ca caturnetraṃ dvikarṇakamdvibhujaṃ ca gadāpāṇiṃ vāme cā'bhayasaṃyutamdakṣe ḍamarukaṃ dhatte vāme caiva triśūlakamdvibhujaṃ hāsyavadanaṃ varā'bhayavidhārakamiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje gaurīśvarasaṃvādeṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥmṛtyuñjayasya pūjāyāḥ kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ vidhānakammṛtyuñjayavidhānaṃ tu na vaktavyaṃ bahirmukhemṛtyuñjayo mahādevaḥ sākṣānmṛtyuharaḥ paraḥdeveśi rogaśāntyarthaṃ tasya pūjāvidhiryathārogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanātyamo'pi praṇamedbhaktyā kiṃ kariṣyati pāmaraḥjātibhedairmṛttikāṃ tu gṛhītvā'śītitolakāmpaurāṇikena mantreṇa kuryācca paṭhanaṃ budhaḥsvasvamantraiśca pratyekadravyeṇa snāpayet sudhīḥupaviśyāsane vipro dhṛtvā dhautaṃ ca vāsasamupacārāḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ tu deyā bhaktyā prayatnataḥvastrayugmaṃ pradadyāttu paridheyaṃ yathā bhavetathavā śṛṇu deveśi yantraṃ sarvasusiddhidamvyādhivyāmohaduḥkhapraśamanamuditaṃ śrīpadaṃ kīrtidāyibilvapatrasahasrantu hyabhagnaṃ vinivedayetsamidbhistu guḍūcyāstu tatra homaṃ samācarettadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā yathāvibhavamānataḥekaliṅgaṃ samārādhya phalaṃ syādanyake yugeāmrapātre tu saṃsthāpya jalaṃ cāśītitolakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣipeddīpaśikhāyāṃ ca mantramuccārya mānakamyādṛgyādṛg bhavedrogo nāśameti mayoditamaṅgavyatikrameṇaiva vṛthā bhavati vāsanāyadi madvacane bhaktistadā mukto bhaveddhruvamanyathā yadi deveśi sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalamsaṃkalpaṃ ca tataḥ kuryādvidhivākyānusārataḥpañcagavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śivamantreṇa mantritamtaduddhṛtya tataścakaṃ sthāpayetsvarṇapātrakepayodadhighṛtakṣaudraśarkarādyauranukramātaṣṭābhiḥ kalaśairdevīmaṣṭābhirvāripūritaiḥsnānaṃ samāpya tāṃ devīṃ sthāpayet svarṇapīṭhakeaṣṭottaraśataṃ devi devatābhāvasiddhayetatrāvāhya mahādevi! jīvanyāsañca kārayetphalatāmbūlanaivedyaiḥ śivaṃ tatra samarcayetaguruṃ cāmaraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ yathāyogyaṃ maheśvariaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā sampātājyaṃ vinikṣipetgurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttato devīṃ visarjayetiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde saptadaśaḥ paṭalaḥsarvaṃ me kathitaṃ deva kavacaṃ na prakāśitamkathayasvādya me nātha yadi sneho'sti māṃ pratisatryakṣarasvarūpo me vadanaṃ ca maheśvaraḥmṛtyuñjayastribījātmā hyāyū rakṣatu me sadāsadā me sarvataḥ pātu ṣaṭtriṃśadvarṇarūpadhṛktrivarṇātmā nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ rakṣatu sarvadāsadā rakṣatu me guhyaṃ sarvasampatpradāyakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mārtaṇḍabhairavo nityaṃ pādau me parirakṣatuūrddhvamūrddhani ceśāno mama rakṣatu sarvadāaghorākhyo mahādevaḥ pūrvasyāṃ parirakṣatuuttarasyāṃ sadā pātu sadyojātasvarūpadhṛkprātarmadhyāhnakāle tu yaḥ paṭhecchivasannidhaukavacaṃ dhārayedyastu sādhako dakṣiṇe bhujeyoginībhūtavetālāḥ pretakūṣmāṇḍapannagāḥpaṭhitvā'bhyarcayeddevi yathāvidhipuraḥsaramtaddhāraṇe mahādevi! mṛtyurogavināśanamiti jñātaṃ mahādevi! tasya vaktre sthitaṃ sadāanyathā siddhihāniḥ syātsatyametanmanoramena deyaṃ kasyacidbhadre yadīcchedātmano hitampaṭalaḥyantradhāraṇamātreṇa sarvābhīṣṭaphalaṃ labhettadā gorocanādyena likhedyantramanuttamampratipadme likhenmāyābījaṃ bhūpurakaṃ tataḥkukṣau dhṛtvā mahāyantraṃ śubhaputravatī bhavetdakṣiṇāṃ gurave dattvā gṛhṇīyādyantramuttamamvṛttamadhye likheddevi sādhakākhyāṃ viśeṣataḥpraṇavaiḥ puṭitā lajjā tridhā patreṣu saṃlikhetsatyaṃ satyaṃ hi deveśi vandhyā putravatī bhavetdurbhagā cedbhavennārī subhagā māsato bhavetdhāraṇāddānavapatirmahārakṣākaro bhavetgaṃ pañcakaṃ sarvamadhye likhitvā dhārayedyadigorocanākuṅkumābhyāṃ bhūrje saṃlikhya dhārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjitaṃ dhāritañcaiva sarvopadravanāśanamgorocanābhiḥ saṃlikhya dhārayetparameśvaripratipatreṣu yaṃbījaṃ likhedatha pṛthakpṛthakkākavandhyājanasyāpi bahuputrakaraṃ paramṣaṭkoṇeṣu ca ṣaṭ dīrghān vilikhetparameśvarisarvamadhye likheddevi tataḥ śṛṇu maheśvarisuputrañca samālikhya utpādaya padantataḥdhāraṇātsarvasampattirbhaveddevi na saṃśayaḥyasya dhāraṇamātreṇa vaśīkuryāt punaḥ priyeoṃ śatrumukhaṃ bandhayeti pratipadmadalaṃ likhetpūrvavatpūjayeddevīṃ japellakṣaṃ vidhānataḥhutvā caiva vidhānena sa vaśī bhavati dhruvambahirbubhūdvayaṃ likhya caturdikṣu ca hrīṃ likhetgrīvāyāṃ kaṇṭhadeśe vā śikhāyāṃ vāpi dhāraṇātpūrvoktavidhinā lakṣaṃ durgāmantraṃ japedbudhaḥcatuṣkoṇadvayaṃ bāhye likhitvā dhārayedyadidhārayet paramaṃ yantraṃ jīvavatsā tato bhavetoṃ hrīṃ devadatta hrīṃ rekhāmadhye likhecchivegorocanākuṃkumena tathaivālaktakena vāpañcāmṛteṣu deveśi jīvavatsā bhaveddhi sāuktarūpe tathā pūjāṃ lakṣamantraṃ japecchiveiti kriyoḍḍīśe mahātantrarāje devīśvarasaṃvāde viṃśatitamaḥ paṭalaḥkṣubdodhabalakāritvāccakṣurdoṣāpahāriṇīghṛtena medhājananī vāgdevī vaśakāriṇīsaindhavena yutā sā hi jaṭharāgniṃ vivarddhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00512 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amlapittaṃ tathā śūlaṃ vināśayati tatkṣaṇātkaivalyajñānadā cetthaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyinī
